summary: An envelope that moves other machines' parameters, up to 8 targets each with its own depth, polarity, range and curve. Note mode: an ADSR started by the notes of a chosen machine (and track) or by its Gate switch. Follower mode: follows the level of a chosen machine's output, with attack and release and a threshold (ducking, envelope-driven filters). Use it for a filter that opens on every note, a pad that ducks under the kick, an effect that opens with the drums.
use_for: Open or duck any parameter from the notes of a machine or the level of its output (ADSR or follower).

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Note: an ADSR started by notes. Follower: follows the level of a machine's output
parameters.how: Chooses an ADSR started by notes (Note) or a follower that tracks the level of a machine's output (Follower).
parameters.sound: Note mode opens and closes with each note; follower mode rises and falls with the loudness of the machine it listens to.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Note: time to rise to the top. Follower: how fast it follows a rise in level
parameters.how: Sets how long the rise takes, from 1 ms to 5 s; in Follower mode, how quickly it follows a louder signal.
parameters.sound: Short is a snap, long is a slow swell.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Note mode: time to fall from the top to Sustain
parameters.how: Sets how long the fall from the top to the Sustain level takes (Note mode).
parameters.sound: Short decays make a pluck; long ones let the movement hang on.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Note mode: the level held while the note is held
parameters.how: Sets the level held while the note stays down (Note mode), from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: At 100 % the movement stays at the top; at 0 % it is a single pluck with no hold.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Note mode: time to fall to nothing after the note ends. Follower: how fast it follows a fall in level
parameters.how: Sets how long the fall to nothing takes after the note ends; in Follower mode, how quickly it follows a quieter signal.
parameters.sound: Short releases cut the movement off; long ones let it trail away.

parameters.name: Threshold
parameters.description: Follower: levels at or under this are zero; 0 dB is the top
parameters.how: Sets the level, from -60 to 0 dB, below which the follower reads zero.
parameters.sound: A higher threshold ignores quiet bleed, so the follower only reacts to the loud hits.

parameters.name: Curve
parameters.description: Bends the output: negative eases out (fast start), positive eases in (slow start)
parameters.how: Bends the output from -100 % (fast start, eases out) to +100 % (slow start, eases in).
parameters.sound: Negative curves make the movement jump then settle; positive curves hold back then rush.

parameters.name: Gate
parameters.description: A manual gate in Note mode: on starts the envelope, off releases it (patterns can write it)
parameters.how: Starts the envelope when switched on and releases it when switched off, with no notes needed (Note mode).
parameters.sound: A pattern writing this switch triggers the envelope on its own steps.

parameters.name: Write glide
parameters.description: Time a target takes to cross its whole range: no write moves further than this allows
parameters.how: Limits how fast a target may move: it takes at least this long to cross its whole range.
parameters.sound: A short glide keeps fast modulation clean; a long one smooths and slows it.
